checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact TopModule interface; 30 input bits concatenated in a,b,c,d,e,f order followed by two one bits; 32 output bits in w,x,y,z order. Combinational continuous assignment with no state or clock.

checks.name: Independent self-checking development simulation
checks.coverage: Zero, all ones, alternating patterns, walking ones and walking zeros for every input bit, and 1000 random inputs; bit-by-bit expected output construction.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed development compilation and all 1064 simulation checks; no RTL revisions were needed. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before development checks.
limitations: Official evaluation was not accessed or run; its results are unavailable.
Development simulation does not exhaust all 2^30 input combinations.
No synthesis, Vivado timing evidence, or board testing was performed.
